parsed_json.up: Select IC50 activities in nM for compounds tested against human TYK2. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then assays on assay_id, then target_dictionary on tid. Filter target_dictionary.pref_name for TYK2 and target_dictionary.organism for human. Filter activities.standard_type for IC50 and activities.standard_units for nM. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Join docs on doc_id to retrieve pubmed_id or doi. Join compound_records on record_id to retrieve compound_key. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
